decisions.after: Jin Gaozu ordered Vice Directors Zhao Renqi and Zhang Wenhao of the Astronomy Bureau, Xu Hao of the Autumn Office, and astronomical advisers Zhao Yanyi, Du Sheng, and Du Chonggui to compare the new calendar against Xuanming and Chongyuan and judge its merits.
decisions.reason: 秋官正 is the Autumn Office director in the astronomy hierarchy, not Ministry of Rites (春官/禮部). The proposed gloss “(Ministry of Justice)” overreads Zhou-ritual justice into a Tang/Five Dynasties astronomical title, so keep Autumn Office without that parenthetical.
秋官正 denotes Director of the Autumn Office; “Director of the Ministry of Rites” is a false equation with 禮部/春官. The proposed replacement matches the Chinese title.
《歐陽史》 is the work title “Ouyang History”; 史 marks the history book, not a personal name Shi. “The Ouyang History” restores the correct referent.
